integration_rule: Primary transactions file matches BTC-SHIELD's transaction ingestion fields; enrichment/edges/wallets are keyed by txid/address for graph and dashboard joins.
ml_rule: Do not train on scenario_label, ground_truth, risk_score, risk_level or signal columns; they are evaluation/demo ground truth and derived metadata.
provenance: Synthetic data. Designed to emulate transaction/network structure for an SIH/academic prototype; it is not real NTRO telemetry, real intercepted traffic, or evidence of real-world illicit activity.
network_safety: IPs are documentation-only TEST-NET ranges; ASNs are identifiers for synthetic network observations and should not be interpreted as real attribution.
